concepts.title: La Alhambra sobre las nubes
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one breathtaking wide 16:9 cinematic architectural 3D concept image for a dark personal portfolio chapter about studying Computer Engineering and Business Administration at Universidad de Granada. An unmistakably recognizable Alhambra of Granada: terracotta Alcazaba fortress, Torre de la Vela, restrained Nasrid palace courtyards, cypresses, elongated reflecting pool. The entire hill rises impossibly above a deep sea of soft moonlit clouds; snow-dusted Sierra Nevada peaks float on the far horizon. Main architecture occupies the right two thirds; left third fades to near black navy negative space for future HTML copy, but DO NOT draw any text or interface. Beautiful sophisticated utopian fantasy grounded in real Andalusian architecture, no invented mosque domes or generic Arabian palace. Along a lower palace terrace, small naturally integrated contemporary university study areas: a few tiny adult students sitting in pairs with laptops, notebooks and coffee at shared tables; the studies are implied through collaboration, not floating code or business icons. Thin water channels form a subtle branching geometric pattern in the courtyard, echoing computation and Nasrid geometry without neon circuitry. Warm amber windows and terraces, cool indigo atmosphere, silver-blue clouds, quiet magical mood. Extremely polished plausible architectural materials, atmospheric depth, realistic lighting, high-end cinematic rendering, not low-poly, not cartoon, not an isometric toy. Eye-level oblique aerial view, monumental scale comparable to an enormous Gateway Arch emerging above clouds. One clear hero and generous breathing room. No text, no watermark, no collage.

concepts.title: El patio de las dos miradas
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a distinct wide 16:9 cinematic 3D architectural concept for Granada university life in a fantastical dark portfolio. View from within a beautiful Nasrid-inspired university courtyard suspended impossibly above clouds. Elegant slender columns, carved warm stone arches, long mirror-still rectangular reflecting pool, cypress silhouettes. THROUGH the arches at the far side, the recognizable real terracotta Alhambra fortress and Torre de la Vela emerge huge above the cloud ocean, with a pale Sierra Nevada horizon. This is an explicitly imagined university space, not a claim of a real UGR campus building. Two intimate learning spaces are integrated into the courtyard: on one side two adult students collaborate over a laptop and discreet translucent geometric prototype; opposite, three adult students gather around a table with open notebooks, paper plans and a tiny physical architectural/business model. No visible readable writing. A few backpacks and coffee cups convey actual student life, not a corporate office. Make these people small but readable, secondary to architecture. The reflecting pool quietly joins both areas, metaphor for computer engineering and business studies. Dark blue hour, amber light from arches, violet haze below the courtyard edges, cinematic silver cloud highlights, calm utopian beauty. Foreground architectural frame and nearer table provide depth; right-center strong hero; left edge relatively dark for possible website copy. Realistic premium materials and volumetric atmosphere, believable scale, no generic sci-fi campus, no domes, no gadget icons, no money symbols, no holographic dashboards, no text, no interface, no logos. Single immersive image, not a collage.

concepts.title: El archipiélago del conocimiento
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One wide 16:9 extraordinary yet restrained cinematic 3D concept painting of Granada as an archipelago of knowledge above a midnight cloud ocean. THREE floating architectural terraces only, arranged in deep perspective, joined by slender elegant illuminated stone footbridges. The largest far-right island carries the unmistakable Alhambra of Granada: elongated terracotta fortified walls, Alcazaba and Torre de la Vela, cypresses, Nasrid architecture, no onion domes. A nearer modest terrace contains a contemporary Andalusian university workshop with warm-lit glass openings, two tiny adult students collaborating over laptops and a physical geometric construction, suggesting computer engineering. A second terrace is an open university plaza with shared study tables, notebooks, a few small groups talking over coffee and an understated scale model, suggesting business studies and student life without corporate clichés. The linking bridges and students walking between them tell the story of a double degree. Monumental architecture rooted in real Granada elements, impossible floating terrain with delicate roots/rock barely emerging through mist, Sierra Nevada snow peaks faint in background. Keep silhouette composition clean and uncluttered; Alhambra is clearly the main focal point. Left quarter mostly deep navy negative space, main composition center-right, good fit for a dark portfolio beside HTML text. Muted terracotta and amber lights against silver-blue clouds and ink-blue sky. Cinematic high-end architectural render with realistic stone, lush cypresses and atmospheric depth; no low-poly islands, no videogame UI, no icons, no currency signs, no floating letters, no readable text, no watermark, no collage.
